cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Say You Saw It Too
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did the chair's shadow reach the door before the chair moved? Give me your own observation, like I used to make you do before comparing notes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No copying your old teacher's answer. Start with what moved first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The shadow. The chair was still against the wall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you separated the two. Now I can tell you I held the door for it. I didn't want that going in your notes until you had your own.

reason: Make prior teaching determine the response, and distinguish surrendering ordinary explanations from hiding culpability or just redirecting why questions. Repair explicit contradictions and give hope scenes real next steps and visible withholding.
